Reason: The CT images demonstrate a right pleural effusion and an anomalous vessel in the right lower lobe draining towards the inferior vena cava (scimitar vein), which is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (a congenital vascular anomaly). Although the question mentions a chest X-ray, the provided figures are CTs confirming this diagnosis, and Option F correctly identifies the key features (right pleural effusion and congenital vascular anomaly) while noting the absence of significant heart enlargement (cardiomegaly), distinguishing it from heart failure.
